newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: S&P rates Marcel Underwriting notes A1-plus.
newsitem.headline: S&P rates Marcel Underwriting notes A1-plus.

text.p: Standard and Poor's Corp said on Monday it has assigned its A1-plus rating to commercial paper notes issued by Marcel Underwriting (No.1) Pty Ltd under the company's A$400 million commercial note programme.
Commonwealth Bank of Australia (CBA) structured and arranged the transaction.

S&P said the rating primarily reflected the provision of an irrevocable, unconditional direct pay letter of credit by the Commonwealth Bank of Australia, New York branch. It said the proceeds of the issue of the notes would utlimately be used to invest in deposits with CBA, Grand Cayman branch.
S&P said Commonwealth Bank of Australia, New York Branch, would provide a letter of credit (LOC) to support the issue of the notes.

"The obligations and nature of the LOC eliminates any exposure of the noteholders to Marcel and allows Standard and Poor's to apply its A1-plus rating of Commonwealth Bank of Australia to the notes," the credit rating agency said.
